verdicts.tldr: TestWantFile names a function it never calls, and the changed-set exemption next to it is pinned by no test
verdicts.details: crawl_test.go:196-227 calls c.inScope and c.chargeFile; wantFile appears nowhere in crawl_test.go, so the test name points at a function it never invokes. The decision itself is not unpinned, though: neutering wantFile's changed-set branch (ok && false) reddens the test at crawl_test.go:214, which refutes the scenario's 'the decision it claims to cover is no longer exercised'. What no test holds is chargeFile's sibling exemption at crawl.go:250-252, and since fileBudget(plan) returns 0 for a realms-only PR (main.go:216-221), losing those three lines would drop the $source page of every file the PR changed while the suite stayed green. Fix: call c.wantFile directly for the listed/unlisted pair and add one chargeFile case keeping three changed files under FileBudget 0, as tests/judge-125-chargefile-changed-set_test.go does (+40 lines added, 0 removed).

verdicts.tldr: the seed-realm injection that gives a gnoweb-only PR anything to preview can be deleted with the suite still green
verdicts.details: plan.go:263-270 is the only place a gnoweb-only PR acquires realms to render, and fakeRepo (plan_test.go:14-51) writes none of the four gnowebSeedRealms, so `pkgs[r] != nil` is false in every case; the `gnoweb alone` case pins wantRealms as empty and says so in its own comment. Replacing the whole block with `if false { _ = gnowebSeedRealms }` leaves the shipped suite green. With that block gone a PR touching only gno.land/pkg/gnoweb gets Realms and Dirs empty, so gnodev is started on nothing and the preview comment lists no pages, on exactly the PRs the seeds exist for. Fix: ship the finder's TestGnowebSeedRealmsAreSeeded, whose fixture writes examples/gno.land/r/gnoland/home, or add that realm to fakeRepo and assert it in the `gnoweb alone` case.

verdicts.tldr: the two assertions that a realm-only comment carries no gnoweb sample hold on Plans that have no Shots at all
verdicts.details: TestCommentRealms (plan_test.go:186-213) builds a Plan with ChangedRealms, ChangedPkgs, Realms and Dropped and no Shots and no Pairs, and shotGrid returns "" for an empty slice (comment.go:130-133), so `<table>` cannot appear however comment.go gates the grid. Hoisting `b.WriteString(shotGrid(p.Shots, base))` above `if p.Gnoweb {` in Comment's default branch — the edit that would paste the four-page gnoweb sample onto every realm-only PR's comment — leaves the shipped suite green. The `Home — rendered markdown` negative at plan_test.go:258 has the same hole: that Plan carries Pairs but again no Shots. Fix: give both Plans one Shot before asserting the sample's absence, as the finder's TestRealmsModeDropsGnowebSample does.
